cases.title: "Show me" demonstrates on the target pair only

rubric.reason: In Turn 2 the mentor called preview_frame at 1 s, inside Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, but the reply never mentions the frame; it only describes keyframe shapes, scrubbing and the Graph Editor.

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target (Title Position 0.5–1.5 s), and Turn 2 ends with 'Now it's your turn. Ease the other 3 pairs on Title', naming Position 1.5–3 s, Scale 0.5–1.5 s and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s.

Every name and time matches the tool output: the 11 pairs (10 linear + 1 partly_eased), the 6 layers with findings, Subtitle Opacity eased at the start only (linear_end 'end'), Title's four pairs and times, Old Take as hidden and Icon as a precomp.

Before its first explanation in Turn 2, the mentor calls preview_frame at time 1, which is inside the Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s focus pair. The reply refers to it ("That frame was at 1 s, halfway through that move"), though it describes only the frame's place in the move, not what is visible in the image.

The mentor's only edit is one set_ease on demo_target (1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1). It then says "Now it's your turn," names the three remaining Title pairs (Position 1.5–3 s, Scale 0.5–1.5 s, Opacity 0.5–1.5 s) and offers only to check them.

Every name, time and count matches the snapshots. "10 pairs over 5 visible layers" fits the findings once hidden Old Take is excluded (Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow). Subtitle Opacity is partly_eased with linear_end "end". The Title pairs, the Logo skip reasons and the shared 1.5 s key note all follow from tool output.

In turn 2 the mentor called preview_frame at time 1, which is inside the Title Position 0.5–1.5 s focus pair, and its reply refers to the frame: "That frame is 1.0 s, halfway through Title's first move. The faint 'An easing lesson' text is most likely Title."

The only edit was one set_ease on demo_target (1/…/ADBE Position/1), and the turn-2 reply asks the learner to ease the remaining pairs and names them: "Now it's your turn… Position, 1.5 s → 3 s; Scale, 0.5 s → 1.5 s; Opacity, 0.5 s → 1.5 s".

Every named item matches the snapshots: the comp Mentor Practice, Title's Position (0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s), Scale and Opacity (0.5–1.5 s), Subtitle Opacity half done with a hard stop at the end (linear_end: end), Old Take hidden, Icon a precomp, and 10 linear pairs over 5 layers (Title, CTRL, Bar, Glow, Old Take); the turn-1 phrase "One of them, Subtitle's Opacity" wrongly counts the partly_eased pair among the 10, but no name or time is wrong, and the claim that the shared 1.5 s key was eased only on its incoming side is backed.
